name: Satomi Hakkenden
source:
"Sliced by a bewitched sword......, Is it an enemy, Is it love?"

It is a turbulent time of wars.
The protagonist, who lives as a man, spends her days peacefully in her hometown Otsuka Village despite the agitated times.
However, a tragedy suddenly comes calling.
Her beloved dog Yoshirou that she thought of as a little brother dies, her father commits ritual suicide...
And into the protagonists hands passes a bewitched sword, the Murasamemaru.
"I want to carry out my father's dearest wish."
In order to give up the Murasamemaru to the Kanto Shogunate, the protagonist decides to hide the fact that she is a woman and rushes away from Otsuka Village on a journey.
The same birthmark, A character carved into a ball, the Kenshi that hold them.
Attracting "Destiny", What future will the protagonist choose...

A love adventure game based on the famous story, "Nansou Satomi Hakkenden".

[Translated from the official site]
translation:
“被魔剑斩断……，是敌人，还是爱情？”

这是一个战乱频仍的时代。
以男人身份生活的主人公，尽管时局动荡，却在家乡大冢村过着平静的日子。
然而，一场悲剧突然降临。
被她视为弟弟的心爱的狗Yoshirou去世了，她的父亲也自杀了……
一把被施了魔法的剑“村雨丸”交到了主角们的手中。
“我要实现父亲最大的心愿。”
为了将村雨丸交给关东幕府，主人公决定隐瞒自己是女性的事实，从大冢村出发踏上旅途。
同样的胎记，刻在球上的文字，持有它们的剑士。
吸引“命运”，主角将选择怎样的未来……

以著名故事《南草里见八剑传》为背景的爱情冒险游戏。
